Construct lazily geometric global-hex data

Source: R/data.R
hex_data.Rd

hex_data() keeps indexed cells and ordinary attribute columns together. It deliberately stores no polygon geometry; geometry is generated only for the cells ultimately selected for display.

Usage

hex_data(cell, ...)

Arguments

cell

A globalhex_cell vector.

...

One or more vectors of cell attributes. Size-one values are recycled by tibble::tibble().

Value

A globalhex_data tibble.

Examples

cells <- point_to_cell(rbind(c(0, 0), c(10, 10)), 5)
x <- hex_data(cells, value = c(1, 2))
x
#> # A tibble: 2 × 2
#>   cell      value
#>   <gh_cell> <dbl>
#> 1 0365650       1
#> 2 0366031       2
